en.title: Paramount+ Drops Two Major US Dramas: What You Need to Know
en.summary: US dramas are landing on UK shores faster than ever, but not all shows get the same fanfare. This week, two highly anticipated series from Paramount+ are making waves, offering a mix of familiar faces and thrilling new narratives.
en.body:
Finding that must-watch US drama on UK services used to feel like a game of chance, but deals between streaming platforms and local broadcasters have significantly shortened the wait. This week, **Paramount+** is at the forefront, bringing two compelling US dramas to screens across the pond. While release dates might not perfectly align with US audiences, the accessibility is a win for dedicated binge-watchers.

## Sheriff Country's Return to Edgewater

The no-nonsense Sheriff Mickey Fox, portrayed by **Morena Baccarin**, is back to tackle more crimes in the charming yet complex town of Edgewater. Season 2 of **Sheriff Country**, the spin-off from **Fire Country**, promises to delve deeper into Mickey's life as she navigates the demands of law enforcement, motherhood, local politics, and a past that refuses to stay buried. Adding a layer of intriguing personal connection, Mickey's real-life husband, **Ben McKenzie**, makes a guest appearance in the premiere episode. He plays Sheriff Wade, a neighboring lawman called in to assist Mickey, who also harbors a few secrets of his own. The season kicks off with the first three episodes premiering on **Paramount+** on October 24th, offering a substantial binge-ready start for fans eager to see Sheriff Fox back in action.

## Dexter Morgan's Deadly Dance Continues

For those who prefer their drama with a darker, more sinister edge, **Dexter: Resurrection** returns to **Paramount+** on October 30th, just in time for spooky season. Two decades after his initial reign of terror, Dexter Morgan, once again embodied by **Michael C. Hall**, finds himself ensnared between two formidable murderers. One is a seasoned killer with a lifetime of kills to his name, while the other is a fresh, terrifying new presence wreaking havoc in New York in unprecedented ways. The situation escalates as Dexter faces an unexpected enemy, hinting at a season filled with psychological twists and high-stakes confrontations that fans have come to expect from the iconic serial killer.

## The Expanding World of Spy Thrillers

Beyond the crime procedural and serial killer dramas, 2026 is shaping up to be a banner year for espionage enthusiasts. The landscape of spy thrillers is expanding with new series and returning favorites. Projects like **Ponies**, which humorously explores the lives of secretaries whose husbands are CIA agents in 1977 Moscow, offer a lighter take on the genre. Meanwhile, **The Agency**, starring **Michael Fassbender**, is set to return for its second season on **Paramount+**. Other notable titles adding to the espionage mix include **The Day of The Jackal**, **Prime Target**, and **Black Doves**, alongside the continued adventures of **Slow Horses** and **The Night Agent**. This surge in spy content caters to viewers seeking intricate plots, moral ambiguity, and global intrigue.

## What's Next

With **Sheriff Country** season 2 launching October 24th and **Dexter: Resurrection** season 2 arriving on October 30th, **Paramount+** is giving UK viewers plenty to sink their teeth into. Keep an eye out for further details on the international release of other 2026 spy thriller series as they are announced.

content_raw: We've all faced the disappointment of finding a US drama we really want to watch, only for it not to be available in the UK. The US is constantly creating must-see entertainment content and you might be thinking that these programs are only available to US audiences — but that's not the case. Thanks to these US streaming platforms securing deals with UK broadcasters like Sky and ITV, we can now watch award-winning content from a variety of genres. Although the UK isn't guaranteed the same release date as those across the pond, it saves you from waiting an age until they reach UK screens. Here are the US dramas available to watch on both UK channels and streaming this week, as well as our top picks. Sheriff Country season 2 No-nonsense sheriff Mickey Fox (Morena Baccarin) is back on the case to investigate more crimes in the small town of Edgewater. The second season of the Fire Country spin-off sees Mickey "balance the demands of law enforcement with the complexities of motherhood, community politics and a past that won't stay buried." Morena's real-life husband Ben McKenzie guest stars in the first episode as Sheriff Wade, a neighbouring sheriff who is called in to assist Sheriff Mickey, and has a few secrets of his own. The first three episodes of Sheriff Country season 2 premiere on Paramount+ on 24 October. Dexter: Resurrection season 2 (Image credit: Paramount+) There's a criminal on the loose this spooky season as Dexter: Resurrection returns to Paramount+ on 30 October. Two decades since his killer debut, this season finds Dexter Morgan ( Michael C. Hall ) caught between two murderers — one with a lifetime of kills behind him, and the other a fresh young face terrorising New York in unprecedented ways. Meanwhile, Dexter also faces an unexpected enemy in the form of a mid-life crisis and Harrison (Jack Alcott) continues his quest for justice as the father-and-son duo face their darkest chapter yet. Nocturne (Image credit: Apple TV) Apple TV 's new crime drama Nocturne features Adolescence star Stephen Graham as cunning serial killer, Jurek Walter, who terrorises the town of Fairhaven in Pennsylvania, despite being in prison. The 10-parter follows ex-soldier and retired police detective Jonah Lynn (Liev Schreiber) as he relocates to the town for a quiet life. However, Jonah, who helped put Jurek behind bars, is soon pulled back into the criminal's terrifying orbit when his family come under threat. A search for Jurek's last missing victim forces Jonah to send FBI Agent Saga Bauer (Zazie Beetz) up against Jurek. But how far will he go to end Jurek's reign of terror once and for all? Nocturne is another killer addition to your Halloween watch list as the first two episodes drop on 30 October.
